title: makeCapturePaneFn (capture-pane -p -t) duplicates dispatch.ts's internal defaul…
description:
makeCapturePaneFn (capture-pane -p -t) duplicates dispatch.ts's internal defaultCapturePaneFn almost verbatim; the production host.ts wiring passes its own -S - capturePane instead, so makeCapturePaneFn is used only by the sidecar call-sites. Consider exporting/reusing a single capture-pane reader to avoid three near-identical readers.
